description: Requires overload signatures to be adjacent to each other
name: adjacent-overload-signatures

description: Disallows the use of Typescript directives without a comment
name: ban-ts-comment

description:
Bans the use of primitive wrapper objects (e.g. `String` the object is a wrapper
of `string` the primitive) in addition to the non-explicit `Function` type and
the misunderstood `Object` type
name: ban-types

description: Warns the usage of unknown rule codes in ignore directives
name: ban-unknown-rule-code

description: Requires `deno-lint-ignore` to be annotated with one or more rule names
name: ban-untagged-ignore

description: Warns unused ignore directives
name: ban-unused-ignore

description: Verifies the correct usage of constructors and calls to `super()`
name: constructor-super

description: Requires `for` loop control variables to increment in the correct direction
name: for-direction

description: Requires all property getter functions to return a value
name: getter-return

description: Enforce conventional usage of array construction
name: no-array-constructor

description: Requires that async promise executor functions are not used
name: no-async-promise-executor

description:
Requires lexical declarations (`let`, `const`, `function` and `class`) in switch
`case` or `default` clauses to be scoped with brackets
name: no-case-declarations

description: Disallows modifying variables of class declarations
name: no-class-assign

description: Disallows comparing against negative zero (`-0`)
name: no-compare-neg-zero

description: Disallows the use of the assignment operator, `=`, in conditional statements
name: no-cond-assign

description: Disallows the use of a constant expression in conditional test
name: no-constant-condition

description: Disallows the use ascii control characters in regular expressions
name: no-control-regex

description: Disallows the use of the `debugger` statement
name: no-debugger

description: Disallows the deletion of variables
name: no-delete-var

description: Warns the usage of the deprecated Deno APIs
name: no-deprecated-deno-api

description: Disallows using an argument name more than once in a function signature
name: no-dupe-args

description: Disallows using a class member function name more than once
name: no-dupe-class-members

description: Disallows using the same condition twice in an `if`/`else if` statement
name: no-dupe-else-if

description: Disallows duplicate keys in object literals
name: no-dupe-keys

description: Disallows using the same case clause in a switch statement more than once
name: no-duplicate-case

description: Disallows the use of empty block statements
name: no-empty

description: Disallows using the empty character class in a regular expression
name: no-empty-character-class

description: Disallows the declaration of an empty enum
name: no-empty-enum

description: Disallows the declaration of an empty interface
name: no-empty-interface

description: Disallows the use of empty patterns in destructuring
name: no-empty-pattern

description: Disallows the reassignment of exception parameters
name: no-ex-assign

description: Disallows use of the `any` type
name: no-explicit-any

description: Disallows unnecessary boolean casts
name: no-extra-boolean-cast

description: Disallows unnecessary non-null assertions
name: no-extra-non-null-assertion

description: <!-- deno-fmt-ignore-file -->
name: no-extra-semi

description: Disallows the implicit fallthrough of case statements
name: no-fallthrough

description: Disallows the overwriting/reassignment of an existing function
name: no-func-assign

description: Disallows assignment to native Javascript objects
name: no-global-assign

description: Disallows reassignment of imported module bindings
name: no-import-assign

description: Disallows easily inferrable types
name: no-inferrable-types

description: Disallows variable or function definitions in nested blocks
name: no-inner-declarations

description: Disallows specifying invalid regular expressions in RegExp constructors
name: no-invalid-regexp

description: Warns the wrong usage of triple-slash reference directives
name: no-invalid-triple-slash-reference

description: Disallows the use of non-space or non-tab whitespace characters
name: no-irregular-whitespace

description: Disallows defining `constructor`s for interfaces or `new` for classes
name: no-misused-new

description: Disallows the use of `namespace` and `module` keywords in TypeScript code
name: no-namespace

description: Disallows the use of `new` operators with built-in `Symbol`s
name: no-new-symbol

description: Disallows calling built-in global objects like functions
name: no-obj-calls

description: Disallows expressing octal numbers via numeric literals beginning with `0`
name: no-octal

description: Disallows the use of `Object.prototype` builtins directly
name: no-prototype-builtins

description: Disallows redeclaration of variables, functions, parameters with the same name
name: no-redeclare

description: Disallows multiple spaces in regular expression literals
name: no-regex-spaces

description: Disallows self assignments
name: no-self-assign

description: Disallows returning values from setters
name: no-setter-return

description: Disallows shadowing of restricted names
name: no-shadow-restricted-names

description: Disallows assigning variables to `this`
name: no-this-alias

description: Disallows use of `this` or `super` before calling `super()` in constructors
name: no-this-before-super

description: Disallows the unreachable code after the control flow statements
name: no-unreachable

description: Disallows the use of control flow statements within `finally` blocks
name: no-unsafe-finally

description:
Disallows the usage of negation operator `!` as the left operand of relational
operators
name: no-unsafe-negation

description: Disallows unused labels
name: no-unused-labels

description: Enforces all variables used at least once
name: no-unused-vars

description:
Enforces the use of block scoped variables over more error prone function scoped
variables. Block scoped variables are defined using `const` and `let` keywords
name: no-var

description: Disallows the use of Web APIs via the `window` object
name: no-window-prefix

description: Disallows the usage of `with` statements
name: no-with

description:
Recommends using const assertion (`as const`) over explicitly specifying literal
types or using type assertion
name: prefer-as-const

description: Recommends declaring variables with [`const`] over [`let`]
name: prefer-const

description:
Recommends the use of `namespace` keyword over `module` keyword when declaring
TypeScript module
name: prefer-namespace-keyword

description: Disallows async functions that have no await expression
name: require-await

description: Disallows generator functions that have no `yield`
name: require-yield

description: Disallows comparisons to `NaN`
name: use-isnan

description: Restricts the use of the `typeof` operator to a specific set of string literals
name: valid-typeof
